_about: R7-W5 (A-104, design 7.6) the program error codes that mean 'the price moved beyond your slippage'. A transaction whose failing top-level instruction ran one of these programs with one of these custom error codes is reported as 'price-moved'; every other error is the generic failure text. wallet-reads.ts SLIPPAGE_ERROR_CODES equals this file (a test keeps them equal).
status: NOT FETCHED: this build had no network access, so the codes were not read from the published IDLs; they are the author's recollection of them. Only codes the author is sure of are listed (an unlisted code falls back to the generic text, which is safe). Before go-live the owner re-checks each entry against the program's published IDL error list (docs/rebuild/CUTOVER.md wallet line).
